verdict.rationale: CSC's entity-management docs mention AI-assisted bulk document imports with automated entity and folder routing. That is a real first-party bulk capability, but it covers only document intake and rests on one marketing line. Nothing documents bulk edits, updates or actions across many entities or records, and nothing shows how an AI-native user would trigger bulk operations programmatically. missing for 10: bulk edit/update/delete across entities or records, bulk actions on filings or SOP items, documented programmatic or API bulk endpoints, limits and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Leverage AI to simplify document management, including bulk document imports, automated entity and folder routing
